blocks.html: You only need to do one of the following methods to get the required armband. You may switch the gangs at the start of this part, e.g. if you finished the previous quest on Black Arm Gang, you can still switch and do the Phoenix Gang method.
Go to the Phoenix Gang Hideout in south-east Varrock, down the ladder into the hideout and talk to Straven, learning the gang password from him (Gherkin). Talk to him one more time.
blocks.text: Go to the Phoenix Gang Hideout in south-east Varrock, down the ladder into the hideout and talk to Straven, learning the gang password from him (Gherkin). Talk to him one more time.
